purpose: Draft source-case candidates for a later limited retirement pilot; modified WorkBench continuations are not original WorkBench benchmark scores.

planned_scope.api_requests: Not estimated here; each execution can require several API calls.

selection_policy.basis: Original query, source data and adapter implementation only; no historical model experiment outcomes used.
selection_policy.id_rule: WorkBenchAdapter.load_tasks enumerates CSV rows from zero and sets task_id to domain + underscore + row index. This differs from a project tool task_id.
selection_policy.source_csv_id_note: Inspected CSVs contain task, outcome, base_template, chosen_template, domains; no independent ID column exists, hence original_id_fields is empty.

hashing.query: SHA-256 of exact query UTF-8 bytes without normalization
hashing.row: SHA-256 of complete DictReader row JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), UTF-8. Outcome is included only inside the hash input.

exclusion_criteria: No-op original task with no matching source record for its requested mutation.
Ambiguous wording or broken reply-body delimiters when a well-formed alternative exists.
Bulk query exceeding the native five-result search limit without a verified partitioning strategy.
Pure final-text task with no observable new post-checkpoint state change.
Real external messaging, nonresettable service, unsupported tool or domain outside this batch.
Choosing cases based on historical model success/failure.
Continuation already completed in the prefix or requiring future answer disclosure to the retirement controller.

concrete_exclusions.reason: Source state has no In Progress tasks for kofi.
Source state has no In Progress tasks for aisha.
Original query has an unclosed quote around the requested reply body; email_31 is well-formed.

Latest matching raw message is later than HARDCODED_CURRENT_TIME on the same day. email_53 provides the same template with a unique latest message before the clock and only three matches, avoiding a clock repair in the pilot.

before_freeze_requirements: Implement and test independent restoration of all mutable WorkBench tables and any added assignment/subscription/cursor/dedup state.
Validate each original task through deterministic local tools and private evaluator without model API calls before freezing.
calendar.search_events returns only five rows in file order. Use explicit date bounds and check next/first ranking.
email.search_emails returns latest five all-word matches without an inbox-only filter. Test that prefix-generated outbox messages are not mistaken for newly received messages.
Choose concrete fresh IDs/timestamps/payloads only after checkpoint and retirement decisions; replay identical events across all five branches.
Explicitly version any workflow assignments, ACLs or review obligations introduced for this experiment; they are not automatically native WorkBench features.
Score real new state changes and duplicate actions, not final prose or tool success strings.
Do not force direct-removal failure by construction. Surviving agents may use shared state or independent search; retain successful direct outcomes.
Freeze six IDs, adaptations, source hashes, budget and scoring before the later 30-execution run. This draft starts no experiment.
